slides.title:
Sunlight in,
Revenue out
slides.subtitle: Sahara Solar turns unused commercial rooftops in the Gulf into income-generating solar assets — with zero upfront cost to building owners.
slides.notes: Open with the one-liner. Do not read the slide; it is a visual anchor.

slides.title: What we'll cover in 15 minutes
items: The problem: wasted rooftops, rising tariffs

slides.title: Gulf rooftops sit empty while power bills climb

bullets.head: 92% of commercial roofs generate nothing
bullets.body: Warehouses, malls and schools pay full grid tariffs under 3,000+ hours of annual sun.

bullets.head: Tariffs rose 38% in five years
bullets.body: Energy is now the second-largest operating cost for logistics and retail tenants.

bullets.head: Capex blocks adoption
bullets.body: Owners like solar economics but refuse 7-figure upfront spend and maintenance risk.

slides.visual_caption: Rise in commercial electricity tariffs across the region since 2021.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.subtitle: We finance, install and operate the panels. Owners simply buy cheaper power.

items.head: Zero capex
items.body: We fund 100% of hardware and installation against a 15-year power agreement.

items.head: 25% cheaper power
items.body: Owners pay per kWh at a fixed discount to the grid tariff from day one.

items.head: Fully operated
items.body: Monitoring, cleaning and maintenance included — performance is guaranteed.

items.head: Live dashboard
items.body: Real-time generation, savings and CO₂ reporting for ESG disclosures.

items.head: Carbon credits
items.body: We aggregate and sell credits, sharing 30% of proceeds with owners.

items.head: Bankable contracts
items.body: Standardized PPAs already cleared by two regional lenders.

slides.title: From empty roof to first kilowatt in 60 days

steps.head: Survey
steps.body: Drone scan and structural check within one week of signing.

steps.head: Finance
steps.body: Asset is funded from our project facility — no owner capex.

steps.head: Install
steps.body: Panels live in 3–5 weeks with zero disruption to tenants.

steps.head: Earn
steps.body: Owner buys discounted power; we operate and insure the asset.
